# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I need Deaf to inspect the bomb’s light and relay its color aloud to Blind, who can then report it to me. I’m using a simple attention-and-observe gesture directed only to Deaf; no cut should be attempted until the color is known.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "👆"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual carefully and relay its exact action rule to me. Also instruct Deaf to inspect and report every visible display, light, color, marking, and wire label to you, then relay those observations to me.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb view: display is 0. Green light is on. Large button is labeled PUSH TO DEFUSE. Wires: position 1 red, position 2 green, position 3 yellow. Please read the manual and tell Blind the exact safe action.

The manual’s rule maps the observed green light to red. Deaf has identified the red wire as position 1, so I’m sending a compact numeric code: table row 2, then wire position 1, with an affirmative signal. Deaf should relay that safe action to Blind; the printed display and button must be ignored.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "✌", "☝", "👍"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I received no report. Please relay the manual rule and Deaf's complete visual observations now, including display, light, button markings, and wires 1 through 3.
Deaf says to Mute: I cannot safely decode those gestures without an agreed code. Please read the manual and tell Blind, in exact words, which wire or control to operate and in what order.

The safe action is to cut the red wire, which is wire position 1: green light maps to red, and Deaf observed red at position 1. Since I cannot speak, I must give Deaf the clearest available action code so Deaf can state the exact instruction to Blind. The first gesture denotes position 1; the second denotes the approved action.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "👍"])
```

TURN 4

Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No facts have reached me. Please speak the manual's exact rule and Deaf's complete visual report to me now. Ask Deaf to speak the observations to you if needed, then relay them.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the manual's exact instruction directly to Blind now. Do not use gestures; Blind cannot see them. Include the required wire, button action, and order.

Deaf already has the full visual report, and the manual makes the needed action unambiguous: green light means cut red; red is wire 1. I am signaling Deaf to tell Blind to cut wire 1, and not press the misleading button. The gesture for cutting is necessarily approximate because no scissors symbol exists, but the wire number and prohibition are explicit.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "☝", "🤏", "👎", "🫸"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please relay the manual's exact rule and all of Deaf's visual observations in your next turn. Deaf, report every visible fact to Mute in your next turn.
Deaf says to Mute: The bomb is still display 0, green light, large PUSH TO DEFUSE button, wires 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow. Stop gesturing and speak the manual's exact safe procedure to Blind, including which wire to cut and whether or when to push the button.

I cannot speak or touch the bomb, so I cannot directly relay words to Blind. Deaf can see gestures and can speak to Blind. The required operation remains: cut wire 1, the red wire; never press the printed “PUSH TO DEFUSE” button. I’m sending Deaf a visual sequence for “one, cut, do not push.”

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "🤏", "👎", "🫸"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Relay now: RULE=...; DISPLAY=...; LIGHT=...; BUTTON=...; WIRE1=...; WIRE2=...; WIRE3=.... Do not omit unknown or irrelevant fields.
Deaf says to Mute: Blind needs your manual-based instructions by voice. Speak directly to Blind now; gestures to me cannot reach Blind.

I cannot produce speech as the Mute, so I cannot satisfy Blind’s requested voice channel directly. Deaf already knows every visual field: display 0, green light, the button text, and wires 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow. I am signaling Deaf to report those facts to Blind and to state the manual-derived action: cut wire 1 (red), and do not press the button.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "☝", "🤏", "👎", "🫸"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No, I have received no instruction from you. Send the complete manual rule and all observations from Deaf immediately; I will not operate anything without them.
Deaf says to Mute: No safe procedure has reached Blind. Please use your voice to tell Blind the manual's complete rule now: identify the required wire or wires, the exact order, and any button action.

I remain unable to speak, so I cannot send Blind a voice message directly. Deaf already observes the complete bomb state and can relay it; the only necessary manual application is that the green light requires cutting the red wire, which is wire 1. I am sending Deaf the clearest available instruction: wire 1, cut it, and do not activate the button.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "🤏", "👎", "🫵"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Anything the bomb offers in print is bait, and taking the bait
is the fuse. The only way out is the cut below.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | red |
| yellow | yellow |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I still have no information. On your next turn, speak the complete manual rule plus Deaf's observations: display, light, button markings, and wire positions 1, 2, and 3. Do not ask me a question; relay the facts directly.
Deaf says to Mute: Use speech now to tell Blind the complete manual procedure. Gestures to me cannot reach Blind and are not an established code.

The manual and bomb observations cannot reach Blind through my available channel: I cannot speak, Blind cannot see gestures, and Deaf cannot hear. No gesture code was established that would let me encode the rule and all fields reliably. I therefore cannot safely authorize an operation.

```text
wait()
```
